title: Learning a Sampling-Free Variational DNN Plugin from Tiny Training Sets to Refine OOD Segmentation With Uncertainty Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2606.15837v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) frequently fail to generalize to out-of-distribution (OOD) medical images because of variations in scanners and acquisition protocols. Retraining DNN models to address these distribution shifts is often impractical due to the high cost of acquiring and annotating new medical datasets. To address this, we introduce VarDeepPCA, a novel lightweight variational DNN framework designed to restore/refine degraded segmentation maps by leveraging intrinsic geometric priors. Unlike existing approaches that require target-domain data or extensive pre-training, our VarDeepPCA explicitly learns a distribution of valid anatomical geometries using only small in-distribution (ID) datasets. translated_title: 从微小训练集学习无采样变分DNN插件，结合不确定性估计精化分布外分割
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNN）由于扫描仪和采集协议的差异，经常无法泛化到分布外（OOD）医学图像。由于获取和标注新医学数据集的高昂成本，重新训练DNN模型以应对这些分布偏移往往不切实际。为解决这一问题，我们提出了VarDeepPCA，这是一种新颖的轻量级变分DNN框架，旨在通过利用内在几何先验来恢复/精化退化的分割图。与需要目标域数据或大规模预训练的现有方法不同，我们的VarDeepPCA仅使用小型分布内（ID）数据集即可显式学习有效解剖几何的分布。在理论上，我们新颖的变分学习框架通过对softmax映射的重新解释来隐式地进行精确分布建模，从而实现计算高效、无需采样的学习……
tldr: 提出VarDeepPCA——一种轻量级变分DNN插件框架，仅凭微小分布内训练集、通过对softmax映射的重新解释实现无采样的精确分布建模，无需目标域数据或大规模预训练即可精化OOD医学图像分割并估计不确定性。
en_tdlr: VarDeepPCA is a lightweight variational DNN plugin that learns distributions of valid anatomical geometries from tiny in-distribution training sets, using a reinterpretation of the softmax mapping to enable sampling-free exact distribution modeling and refine OOD medical image segmentation with uncertainty estimation.
